episodes.title: The Darkest Hour Is Just Before the Dawn
episodes.summary: Recently transferred to the Department of Mental Health, Jeong Da-eun's first patient is Oh Ri-na — a woman who appears to be perfectly fine.

episodes.title: Not in the Mood for Work
episodes.summary: Da Eun overhears the hard truth and is hurt by it. As tensions come to a head, doctors and nurses settle their disagreements the old-fashioned way.

episodes.title: Safety Net
episodes.summary: Trainee nurses visit the psychiatric ward, but one of them displays strange behavior. Da Eun accidentally learns a secret about her bestie, Song Yoo Chan.

episodes.title: In Search of a Ray of Hope
episodes.summary: A hostile patient accuses Da Eun of stealing money. Meanwhile, Min Deul Re offers Hwang Yeo Hwan a glimpse into her life to show him her reality.

episodes.title: When Life Tells You to Slow Down
episodes.summary: During an emergency, Da Eun sees another side of Dr. Dong Go Yoon. Senior nurse Park Soo Yoon relates to a patient juggling motherhood and work.

episodes.title: A Day in the Life of a Mage
episodes.summary: Facing monetary issues, Deul Re distances herself from Yeo Hwan. Da-eun grows concerned about a discharged patient reintegrating into his daily life.

episodes.title: The Left Behind
episodes.summary: Da Eun's friends and colleagues worry for her after a tragedy while the doctors, nurses and patients learn about treating PTSD.

episodes.title: Expiration Date on Grief
episodes.summary: Finding it hard to heal without slowing down, Da Eun tries to face her emotions. Yeo Hwan and Go Yoon commiserate over their relationship issues.

episodes.title: I'm a Nurse With Depression
episodes.summary: Deul Re deals with her mother's return. Da Eun finds herself in her patients' shoes as she grapples with her own diagnosis.

episodes.title: The Hardest Part of a Journey
episodes.summary: Da Eun learns how to prioritize herself, but faces fears of returning to work — until she receives empathetic words of courage from the head nurse.

episodes.title: And The Journey Continues
episodes.summary: Now the subject of office gossip, Da Eun returns to work. During a night out with friends, Deul Re rediscovers what makes her happy.

episodes.title: Daily Dose of Sunshine
episodes.summary: Da Eun manages to find a unique way to help her patient. Deul Re pursues her passion and Yoo Chan takes a bold stand.
